implementation_constraints: Reads all stdin, writes only stdout, performs no filesystem or network access.
Always exits 0; malformed batch input prints exactly ERROR.

unresolved_intent.decision: A request object is structurally valid when it is a JSON object with string method and string path; body, when present, may be any JSON value.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The batch-level malformed-input rule says request objects require method/path/body shape, while AC-RH-05 needs non-object POST/PUT bodies to become per-request 400 responses rather than aborting the whole batch.

unresolved_intent.decision: Any method on exactly /items other than GET or POST returns 405, and any method on /items/<positive integer> other than GET, PUT, or DELETE returns 405.
unresolved_intent.rationale: Those URL shapes are defined resources even when a specific method is unsupported, so they must be distinguished from paths the API does not define.

unresolved_intent.decision: Returned item objects are shallow copies of stored items, and GET /items returns a new list preserving current stored order.
unresolved_intent.rationale: The API is transport-shaped and JSON-serialized, so responses should reflect values without exposing internal mutable state during processing.

unresolved_intent.decision: Paths are matched literally; query strings, trailing slashes such as /items/, and extra path segments are treated as undefined paths returning 404.
unresolved_intent.rationale: Query strings and extra routing behavior are out of scope, and the canonical routes only define exact /items and /items/<id> shapes.
